title.zh: 宣布每年11月5日为“Ormoc市纪念日”，即Ormoc市常规工作假日，以纪念1991年11月5日惨剧的法案
title.en: An Act Declaring November 5 of Every Year as "Remembrance Day in Ormoc City," a Regular Working Holiday in Ormoc City, to Commemorate the November 5,1991 Tragedy
title.orig: An Act Declaring November 5 of Every Year as "Remembrance Day in Ormoc City," a Regular Working Holiday in Ormoc City, to Commemorate the November 5,1991 Tragedy

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2001/ra_9068_2001.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: November 5 of every year is hereby declared as "Remembrance Day in Ormoc City," a regular working holiday for the City of Ormoc, Province of Leyte.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in at least two (2) national newspapers of general circulation.
